images.label: Early fall
images.prompt: Create ONE genuinely new, photorealistic in-between seasonal photograph. NOT a blend, collage, ghosted double exposure or transition composite. IMAGE 1 is the immutable CAMERA / ARCHITECTURE MASTER. IMAGE 2 and IMAGE 3 are approved SEASONAL endpoint references ONLY. The output must keep IMAGE 1's exact full-frame crop, front-left viewpoint, house scale, geometry and architectural coordinates: every roof edge, chimney, dormer, window frame/mullion, cedar board, star, deck/railing/lattice, stonework, garage and porch post. Preserve bird feeder/pole, birdbath, red grill and existing tree trunks/branches in precisely the same places. Never adopt another camera or recompose. Same real property, no new objects or landscaping. Only vegetation season, snow/frost, daylight direction/color and physically plausible existing-window light may change. Preserve the existing lower-left MLS mark. Keep all panes and fine structural lines sharp and singular. Natural restrained colors, no HDR, fantasy glow or sunbeams. Use both neighboring approved references to interpolate appearance, but use the unchanged master for structure.  This stage is 1/3 of the seasonal change from IMAGE 2 to IMAGE 3. Early September: mostly green canopy with subtle yellow/red tips, slightly more moss and a few scattered dry leaves. Sun is mid-afternoon, gently warmer and lower than summer, sky stays mostly clear pale blue with very faint wisps. Lawn remains close to summer with a little more shaded green. Windows mostly reflective; barely any interior warmth.

registration.algorithm: Robust affine fit to native Vision revision-1 flow on stable architectural texture; no dense warp
